summary.en: Metals, ceramics, polymers and composites differ first in how their atoms bond, and that difference propagates into every property that decides where each one is used.
summary.et: Metallid, keraamika, polümeerid ja komposiidid erinevad kõigepealt selle poolest, kuidas nende aatomid seonduvad, ja see erinevus kandub edasi igasse omadusse, mis otsustab, kus kumbagi kasutatakse.
